title: The framework from neuroscience and psychology together will be better than folk psychology

statements.text: The theoretical framework that comes from the co-evolution of neuroscience and psychology is bound to be superior to folk psychology, and no adequate theory of the mind-brain is likely without detailed knowledge of the structure and organization of nervous systems.

sources.quote: the theoretical framework resulting from a co-evolution of neuroscience and psychology is bound to be superior to folk psychology
